boundary: Actual TypeScript history model, history service decoders and readOwnedResult; synthetic RPC transport/session/clock. No hosted server latency, database load, Android or two-device delivery measurement.

observedClientRpcCounts.scenario: Following live tail with 3 new TEXT/PHOTO/VOICE rows and an overlapping newest page
Disconnected newest page after a burst of 150 messages
observedClientRpcCounts.unit: RPC reads per refresh; contiguous retained interval and newer cursor preserved
RPC reads per refresh; no jump over unseen messages

observedClientRpcCounts.scenario: 100 duplicate refresh hints during one in-flight refresh
observedClientRpcCounts.unit: Total RPC reads for initial plus one coalesced trailing refresh

covered: Replacements and removals in the covered interval
Stale probe cannot resurrect removed rows
200-message bound and anchor moved during refresh
Access revoked or account closing clears projection
Foreign account/agreement or non-authoritative receipt rejected
Transient read fallback and retry state
Retired visit and changed session fences
15-second overall deadline and no late fallback

remaining: Anchored or disconnected intervals deliberately retain the additional read. A physical phone must verify scroll position, media playback and reconnect behavior in the built app.
